description: This file contains code for building and validating superblocks and challenges in the FreeCodeCamp curriculum, including classes for processing blocks and superblocks, validation functions, and transformation utilities.

classes.name: BlockCreator
classes.description: Class responsible for reading block directories, parsing challenges, and validating them against meta information.

classes.name: SuperblockCreator
classes.description: Class responsible for processing multiple blocks into a superblock structure.

methods.name: validateChallenges
methods.description: Validates challenges against meta.json challengeOrder, checking for missing, duplicate challenges, and title conflicts.

methods.name: buildBlock
methods.description: Constructs a block object from found challenges and meta data, ordering challenges accordingly.

methods.name: addMetaToChallenge
methods.description: Adds meta information to a challenge object, including challenge order, superblock info, and other properties.

methods.name: challengeFilesToPolys
methods.description: Converts challenge files into polyvinyl objects with seed property for processing.

methods.name: fixChallengeProperties
methods.description: Fixes challenge properties by converting challenge files and solutions into polyvinyl objects.

methods.name: finalizeChallenge
methods.description: Finalizes a challenge by fixing properties and adding meta information.

methods.name: processSuperblock
methods.description: Processes an array of blocks into a superblock structure, invoking block processing.

methods.name: transformSuperBlock
methods.description: Transforms superblock data to extract an array of block info objects, handling different data formats.
